gaps.lead: The lecture was cancelled because nobody came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.

gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: She is too young to drive.

gaps.answer: has got used to / is used to
gaps.lead: She moved to Paris and now finds the pace normal.
gaps.sentence: She ___ the pace of life in Paris.
gaps.explanation: get used to / be used to + -ing or noun: is now used to. 'got used to' also fits if the process is complete.

gaps.lead: She speaks French fluently; she also speaks Russian.
gaps.sentence: She speaks French fluently and, ___, Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition adds a parallel fact: and, in addition, Russian.

gaps.lead: Everybody says he is the best dentist in town.
gaps.sentence: He ___ the best dentist in town.
gaps.explanation: be supposed to be = generally believed to be.
